name: badge
description: A small colored label that states the status of the thing next to it, such as Active, Draft or Failed. Static text, not a control: for something clickable use a button, for a count on a button put the number in its label. Pick the variant by meaning: success for done or healthy, warning for needs attention, danger for failed or blocked, primary for new or highlighted, neutral for everything else.

props.name: variant
props.description: The status the badge stands for; each has its own color. The words must say it too, since color alone is missed by some readers.

props.name: children
props.description: The status in a word or two.
